title: Amazon needs to tweek this service to benefit it's customers
text:
This service is more geared towards benefitting Amazon than it's subscriber base. The amount of time given to cancel a shipment is too narrow and although many of the albums are good ones, they are often cheaper to purchase through a regular buy than through the subscription service. I've had a few that were sent out which I already had in my collection that I just gave away because sending them back is a pain.
C'mon Amazon, this is a service that has a potential to be great, but lets make it easier and more beneficial for your customers. I want to love this service, but right now I just can't.
label: negative
